summary: You take two ILAC courses with a significant Lusophone component; the audit checks that they are ILAC courses, and the Director of Undergraduate Studies' approval of their Lusophone content is checked by hand. The minor is at least six courses of 3 units or more and 23 units in all. The rest of the units come from ILAC literature and culture courses numbered 100-299 and up to 12 units of second-year or higher Portuguese language, all letter graded. Approved independent study, BOSP courses (up to 10 units) and one outside course (up to 5 units) are moved in by hand. The units cannot also count toward another major or minor, which you check yourself.
